# Zero UIV Cyber Slider

A highly customizable, Uiverse-inspired Cyberpunk range slider for Lit.

## Features

- ✅ Angular techy design with polygon clip-paths
- ✅ High-contrast neon primary color
- ✅ Dynamic value display with techy labels
- ✅ Pure CSS (No Tailwind)
- ✅ Fully customizable via RendererAttributes (Cyber Color, Label)
- ✅ ADA Compliant

## Installation

```html
<script src="path/to/zero-uiv-slider-cyber.js" type="module"></script>
```

## Usage

```html
<zero-uiv-slider-cyber 
    label="Shield Power" 
    cyber-color="#f8f005"
    value="85">
</zero-uiv-slider-cyber>
```

## CSS Variables

- `--uiv-cyber-primary`: Accent and border color
- `--uiv-cyber-bg`: Track background
